description: Get the original-language (Italian) text of one article of an Italian national act, as of a given date. "urn" is the bare act citation (e.g. "urn:nir:stato:decreto.legislativo:2003-06-30;196", from it_normattiva_search or it_normattiva_get_act) and "article" is the article number, e.g. "1", "2", "12-bis". Pass as_of (YYYY-MM-DD) to resolve the version of that article in force on that date (multivigenza) — publication, emanation and in-force-from/until dates all come back as separate fields. original: true returns the article as originally enacted. annex selects an article inside an allegato (annex) rather than the main act body. Source: Istituto Poligrafico e Zecca dello Stato (IPZS), Normattiva Open Data.

annex.description: Optional allegato (annex) number/identifier, if the article is inside an annex rather than the main body.

as_of.description: YYYY-MM-DD — the version in force on this date (multivigenza). Omit for the current consolidated text.

original.description: true — return the article as originally enacted, ignoring later amendments.

urn.description: Bare act citation, e.g. "urn:nir:stato:decreto.legislativo:2003-06-30;196" (no article suffix).

name: it_normattiva_get_article
title: It Normattiva Get Article
